name: Leper gnome
summary: Across Azeroth, leper gnomes endure the ruin of Gnomeregan. Most still dwell in the city, changed by its toxic fallout and loyal to Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

sections.title: The Fall of the Great City
sections.body: Troggs broke into Gnomeregan during the Third War. Mekgineer Thermaplugg urged High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque to flood the city with radioactive toxins. He claimed they would kill the troggs and spare the gnomes. Instead, eighty percent of the city's inhabitants died. Survivors sealed in the lower levels were warped in mind and body by the fallout. Their pale, pustulant forms became known as leper gnomes.

sections.title: Thermaplugg's Enclave
sections.body:
Mekgineer Thermaplugg also succumbed to the poisonous fallout. His complexion changed, and his sanity failed. He named himself techno-overlord and King of Gnomeregan, then gathered the crazed survivors in the Tinkers' Court. Many now mistake surface dwellers for trogg intruders. They attack returning rescue parties with frantic savagery.

The survivors pilot salvaged mechanical constructs and build volatile ordnance. With fanatical devotion, they guard Thermaplugg's kingdom.

sections.title: Scattered Across Azeroth
sections.body: Most leper gnomes remain trapped in Gnomeregan's contaminated corridors, though a handful have reached the wider world. Some, driven by desperation or dark ambition, have joined the Dark Iron dwarves in Blackrock Depths. Others operate machinery for the Venture Company in Stonetalon. A few serve as lab assistants to the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society in the depths of the Undercity.

sections.title: The Search for a Cure
sections.body: Gnome scholars exiled in Ironforge still seek ways to help their irradiated kin. In Dun Morogh, engineers and tinkers Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket work on Operation Recombobulation. They hope to reverse the mutation through alchemy or machinery. Whether toxic fallout can break a mind beyond repair remains unanswered.

faq.q: What turned the gnomes into leper gnomes?
aliases: how did they become leper gnomes
faq.answer: During the trogg invasion of Gnomeregan, Mekgineer Thermaplugg urged High Tinker Mekkatorque to release radioactive vents and purge the caverns. The toxins failed to kill the troggs. Instead, they irradiated trapped gnomish citizens, changing their bodies and destroying their sanity.

No. Leper gnomes are living gnomes, changed in body by severe radiation poisoning. Some serve alongside the Forsaken in Lordaeron because of their affinity for blight and toxins. Radiation from gnomish engineering caused their affliction, not necromancy.

Gnome inventors Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket are testing recombobulation devices and alchemical washes. Some experiments show minor promise, but no reliable cure can reverse both the physical rot and deep mental decline.

Mekgineer Thermaplugg leads the leper gnomes as their despotic techno-overlord. Mutated by the radiation he insisted on releasing, he rules from the Tinkers' Court in Gnomeregan. He uses the survivors' fractured minds to keep control of the ruins.

faq.q: Why do leper gnomes attack anyone who enters Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Prolonged exposure to radioactive gasses shattered their minds. In paranoia and delirium, most leper gnomes see any outsider, even an uncorrupted surface gnome, as a trogg invader bent on their destruction.

faq.q: Why are some leper gnomes working with the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Some leper gnomes, including Ganoosh in the Undercity's Apothecarium, have joined the Forsaken. The Royal Apothecary Society employs them as research assistants, valuing their affinity for plague and blighted alchemy. They also value the gnomes' survival despite severe bodily decline.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may see leper gnomes as a reminder of Gnomeregan's fall and the cost of Mekkatorque's trust in Thermaplugg. Exiled gnomes in Tinker Town grieve for them and remain determined to find a cure.
As Forsaken, you may find common ground with these irradiated outcasts. Forsaken apothecaries look past their diseased forms and put their mechanical skills to work in Undercity labs.
As an engineer, you may recognize that leper gnomes retain an uncanny skill for assembly lines, automated defense turrets, and high-voltage devices, even in their madness.
